@copilot Apply the user's requested simplification directly to this existing GenAI PR #20878. The user approved replacing awkward interface-default fallback delegation with the direct nullable exception-class expression in four non-HTTP getter-family PRs. This assignment is ONLY this PR; do not create another PR or update other branches.

Keep getErrorType() authoritative for the final error.type and retain its default method. In overrides that fall back to the exception-only getter default, replace the fallback-only interface-qualified super.getErrorType(request, response, error) call with the equivalent direct expression: error == null ? null : error.getClass().getName(). A local guard that already proves the throwable is non-null can simply return its class name. Apply this to affected production overrides and changed test fixtures; preserve ordinary inheritance that performs additional classification rather than merely supplying this fallback. Do not introduce a helper, common base class, cross-domain abstraction, flag, or new API to hide the expression.

Revise the affected GenAiAttributesGetter.getErrorType Javadoc so it explains the final-value contract and how an override can return the exception class as fallback without recommending or requiring interface-default delegation. Update this PR's existing breaking-change CHANGELOG entry wherever it mandates or demonstrates such delegation, keeping it concise and not adding a second entry. Keep default exception fallback, no-error null, custom classifications, explicit-null omission, and direct extractor writes exactly as implemented. Delegation remains technically possible, but it is no longer the prescribed migration pattern.

Include OpenAI chat and embedding overrides. Preserve service-error-code priority and OpenAiErrorType handling of malformed SDK error data. Inherited Bedrock/Spring AI defaults and streaming lifecycle must remain unchanged.

This is a behavior-preserving simplification of already verified code. Preserve every existing protocol/service-code precedence rule, selected exception identity, cancellation case, deliberate null omission, _OTHER rule, span status, metrics, lifecycle, and semconv selection. Preserve this PR's current base and draft/ready state. Other getter families, HTTP PR #20881, and held Dubbo PR #20782 are out of scope. HTTP needs its role-specific status/exception/_OTHER default policy and must not be simplified to this expression. Do not implement span-status alignment or make getErrorType mandatory.

Follow CONTRIBUTING.md and applicable repository instructions. Do not add Nullable annotations in test code. Keep focused existing default/custom/null and affected-override tests, adjusting only what this simplification requires. Apply the narrowest applicable spotlessApply directly before the targeted behavioral validation, run relevant central extractor and affected-module tests where feasible, and report genuine blockers without unrelated fixes. Acceptance is no fallback-only super delegation remaining for this getter family in the migrated overrides, equivalent telemetry behavior, and Javadoc/changelog guidance consistent with the direct expression. Leave PR title/body edits and review-thread handling to the coordinator.

replies.body: Applied in b0366dac: both OpenAI getters now use the direct nullable exception-class fallback, and the Javadoc and existing changelog entry prescribe that expression. The OpenAI service-code classification remains first.

@copilot Update this existing PR #20878 directly with the following scoped refactor requested by the user. Keep its existing head branch, base, and draft state. Commit and push the changes to this PR, not a new follow-up PR. The previous contract and Javadoc assignments are complete; this is a new request.

In instrumentation/openai/openai-java-1.1/library/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/openai/v1_1/OpenAiErrorType.java, keep the helper name getErrorType and make it return the complete error classification. Return the OpenAIServiceException code when the accessor supplies a value. Otherwise return the original error's class name, or null if error is null. A missing code and an OpenAIInvalidDataException thrown by the typed code accessor must reach the same original-error class-name fallback. Do not classify the accessor exception itself. Keep the existing narrowly scoped accessor exception handling; do not add broad catches or change unwrapping or cancellation behavior. Preserve every non-null service-code string exactly, including empty strings and whitespace.

Simplify both ChatAttributesGetter.getErrorType and EmbeddingAttributesGetter.getErrorType to return OpenAiErrorType.getErrorType(error) directly, removing their duplicated fallback expressions. The user chose consolidation rather than renaming the helper to getServiceErrorCode: both consumers need a complete classification, and there is no independent raw-service-code consumer. Keep the overall GenAI getter/extractor contract, defaults, current Javadocs, telemetry, span status and service-code precedence unchanged. Do not call an interface-super default or reintroduce extractor fallback. Avoid unrelated cleanup and changes to other PRs.

Add or adapt focused helper coverage for null, an ordinary exception, a service exception with a code, a missing code, and a malformed code whose SDK accessor throws. Reuse the existing ServiceErrorTest coverage for chat, embeddings, sync/async and streaming paths rather than duplicating its broad integration matrix. Its expected classifications, including empty and whitespace code values, must remain unchanged. Apply the narrow relevant formatting task and run the smallest tests covering the helper and the existing service-error behavior. Report any execution blocker accurately. Do not wait for CI, merge main or sibling branches, rebase, reply to humans, resolve unrelated threads, or change the PR title or description; the coordinator handles metadata.
